title: Lieutenant Governor of Andaman and Nicobar Islands meets Prime Minister
body_text:
The Lieutenant Governor of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Dr. Dinesh Sharma, today met Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared:
"Lieutenant Governor of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, @LG_ANI_DrDinesh, met Prime Minister @narendramodi."
Lieutenant Governor of Andaman and Nicobar Islands, @LG_ANI_DrDinesh , met Prime Minister @narendramodi . pic.twitter.com/dz3g8JCVdW — PMO India (@PMOIndia) September 22, 2026
